# Volture egg

Type: Material | Internal ID: VoltureEgg | Source: Volture | Usage: Cooking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Volture eggs can be found inside Volture nests in the Ashlands biome. They are also dropped by Voltures.
Unlike other eggs, Volture eggs do not hatch into Voltures.

### Crafting

• Uncooked roasted crust pie
